title: An Algorithmic Roadmap to Unification: Proposing an AI-Driven Search for Spacetime as a Quantum Error-Correcting Code

contributions.purpose: 提出统一物理的单一可证伪假设
contributions.mechanism: 综合全息原理(AdS/CFT)、量子信息、强化学习,论证物理定律是低复杂度量子纠错码(QECC)的涌现属性
contributions.evaluation: 定性/理论:无实验,给出一系列全息-纠缠对应方程(RT 公式等)作论证支撑
contributions.domain: 量子引力/AI for 理论物理
contributions.source_quote: The fundamental laws of nature are the emergent properties of a specific, low-complexity quantum error-correcting code, and the discovery of this "cosmic code" is a well-defined computational search problem amenable to exploration by a purpose-built AI.

contributions.purpose: 设计自动化发现框架的架构
contributions.mechanism: 符号回归生成新 QECC + 深度强化学习对照已知物理原理做验证的两段式引擎
contributions.evaluation: 定性:仅给架构设计与理论 rationale,无运行结果
contributions.source_quote: an automated discovery framework that uses symbolic regression to generate novel QECCs and deep reinforcement learning to validate them against known physical principles

contributions.purpose: 确立可证伪的研究纲领
contributions.mechanism: 给出理论论证+架构蓝图,声称为 21 世纪理论物理设定新研究纲领
contributions.evaluation: 定性:自认为"hypothesis generator that needs experimental validation"
contributions.source_quote: establishing a new, falsifiable research program for 21st-century theoretical physics

notes: 非实证类适配问题:94 页纯理论 roadmap/proposal,零实验——Paper Checklist 自认"The paper's scope remains theoretical without experimental results"。内部矛盾/数据红旗:AI Involvement checklist 却给"Experimental design and implementation"答 [D] 并提到"n=50"实验与"comparing to current experimental bounds",与"无实验"自述冲突(引用了并未真正开展的实验)。高度数学化但实践上难证伪;三/四象限自评。type=method(未验证的提出框架)。
